title.en: Vital Signs and Laboratory Reference Intervals
title.zh: 生命徵象與檢驗參考值

overview.en: This chapter covers how and when to measure temperature, pulse, respirations, blood pressure, oxygen saturation and pain, followed by pain-management interventions and drugs. It then lists high-yield laboratory reference intervals (electrolytes, coagulation studies, CBC, lipids, glucose/HbA1c, renal tests, WBC) with causes of abnormal results and nursing implications.
overview.zh: 本章說明體溫、脈搏、呼吸、血壓、血氧飽和度與疼痛的測量時機與方法,以及疼痛處置與藥物;接著列出常考的檢驗參考值(電解質、凝血功能、全血球計數、血脂、血糖/HbA1c、腎功能、白血球)及異常原因與護理意義。

heading.zh: 生命徵象:原則與測量時機

points.en: Vital signs are temperature, pulse, respirations, BP, pulse oximetry and pain; the first set is the baseline.
points.zh: 生命徵象包括體溫、脈搏、呼吸、血壓、血氧飽和度與疼痛;第一次測量作為基準值。

points.en: Assistive personnel may measure routine vital signs, but the nurse interprets findings and reports abnormal values to the provider.
points.zh: 輔助人員可測量常規生命徵象,但解讀結果並通報異常的責任在護理師。

points.en: Measure on admission, during assessment, before/after invasive or surgical procedures, with drugs affecting heart/lungs/temperature, before/during/after transfusion, with any change in condition, and every 2-4 hours with fever or infection.
points.zh: 測量時機:入院、評估時、侵入性檢查或手術前後、使用影響心肺或體溫藥物時、輸血前中後、病情改變時,以及發燒或感染時每 2-4 小時。

points.en: Postoperative rising heart rate with falling BP and SpO2 suggests bleeding.
points.zh: 術後心跳上升、血壓與血氧下降提示出血。

points.en: Normal range about 97.0-99.0 F (36.1-37.2 C); many settings define fever as 100.4 F (38 C) or higher.
points.zh: 正常範圍約 97.0-99.0 F(36.1-37.2 C);許多機構以 100.4 F(38 C)以上定義為發燒。

points.en: Rectal readings run about 1 F higher; tympanic and axillary about 1 F lower than oral. Temperature is lowest on waking and peaks late afternoon/evening.
points.zh: 肛溫約高 1 F;耳溫與腋溫約低 1 F。體溫起床時最低,傍晚到晚上最高。

points.en: Oral: wait 15-30 min after hot/cold food, smoking or gum; avoid with nasal congestion. Rectal: left side-lying, insert about 1.5 in (3.8 cm), 0.5 in in infants.
points.zh: 口溫:進食冷熱食物、吸菸或嚼口香糖後等 15-30 分鐘;鼻塞者避免。肛溫:左側臥,插入約 1.5 吋(3.8 公分),嬰兒 0.5 吋。

points.en: No rectal temperatures in cardiac clients, rectal surgery, diarrhea, fecal impaction or bleeding risk. Axillary is least accurate. Temporal probe may go behind the earlobe if diaphoretic.
points.zh: 心臟病患者、肛門手術後、腹瀉、糞便嵌塞或有出血風險者不量肛溫。腋溫最不準確。出汗時顳動脈探頭可置於耳垂後。

points.en: Conversion: F to C = (F - 32) x 5/9; C to F = C x 9/5 + 32.
Inability to obtain a temperature should not be ignored; it may be hypothermia in infants or older adults.
points.zh: 量不到體溫不可忽視,在嬰兒或老年人可能是低體溫。

points.en: Adult heart rate 60-100 bpm; assess rate, rhythm, strength and equality. Pulse grade: 4+ bounding, 3+ full, 2+ normal, 1+ weak, 0 absent.
points.zh: 成人心率 60-100 次/分;評估速率、節律、強度與對稱性。脈搏分級:4+ 洪大、3+ 飽滿、2+ 正常、1+ 微弱、0 無。

points.en: Heart rate rises with exercise, pain, fever, emotions, stimulants, hypovolemia and hemorrhage; it slows with age and with depressant/cardiac drugs.
points.zh: 運動、疼痛、發燒、情緒、興奮劑、血容不足與出血會使心率上升;年齡增加及抑制劑/心臟藥物使心率減慢。

points.en: Apical pulse (left midclavicular 5th intercostal space) is counted for 1 full minute for irregular pulse, cardiac disease, before digoxin or beta blockers, and in children under 2.
points.zh: 心尖脈(左鎖骨中線第五肋間)須測滿 1 分鐘,適用於不規則脈搏、心臟疾病、給予 digoxin 或乙型阻斷劑前,及 2 歲以下兒童。

points.en: Pulse deficit = radial rate lower than apical rate; indicates poor perfusion/dysrhythmia; notify the provider.
points.zh: 脈搏短絀 = 橈動脈脈率低於心尖脈率,表示周邊灌流不良或心律不整,須通報醫師。

points.en: Adult respiratory rate 12-20/min; count for 30 sec x 2 unless ill or irregular (then 1 full minute); assess rate, depth, pattern and sounds.
points.zh: 成人呼吸 12-20 次/分;測 30 秒乘 2,若病重或不規則則測滿 1 分鐘;評估速率、深度、型態與呼吸音。

points.en: High CO2/low O2 raise the rate; head injury/raised ICP and opioids depress breathing.
points.zh: CO2 升高或 O2 降低使呼吸加快;頭部外傷/顱內壓上升及鴉片類藥物抑制呼吸。

points.en: Adult categories: normal below 120/80; elevated 120-129 and under 80; stage 1 130-139 or 80-89; stage 2 at least 140 or 90; crisis over 180 and/or over 120.
points.zh: 成人分類:正常低於 120/80;偏高 120-129 且舒張壓小於 80;第 1 期 130-139 或 80-89;第 2 期 140 以上或 90 以上;高血壓危象收縮壓大於 180 和/或舒張壓大於 120。

points.en: Orthostatic vitals: BP and pulse supine, sitting, standing, 1-3 minutes after each change.
points.zh: 姿位性生命徵象:分別於平躺、坐、站姿測血壓與脈搏,每次改變姿勢後 1-3 分鐘測量。

points.en: Avoid cuffs on arms with IV, AV fistula/shunt, breast/axillary surgery or trauma. No smoking or exercise 30 min before; rest 5 min seated with feet flat.
points.zh: 避免在有靜脈輸液、動靜脈瘻管/分流、乳房/腋下手術或外傷的手臂上量血壓。測前 30 分鐘勿吸菸或運動;坐姿雙腳平放休息 5 分鐘。

points.en: Too-small cuff gives a falsely high reading; too-large gives a falsely low reading. Systolic is Korotkoff phase 1; diastolic is phase 5.
points.zh: 壓脈帶太小使讀數偏高,太大使讀數偏低。收縮壓為 Korotkoff 第 1 期,舒張壓為第 5 期。

points.en: SpO2 normal 95-100%; below 90% requires notifying the provider (except some chronic conditions). Nail polish, motion, hypotension, anemia and poor perfusion distort readings; do not use a cold extremity.
points.zh: SpO2 正常 95-100%;低於 90% 須通知醫師(部分慢性病患除外)。指甲油、移動、低血壓、貧血與灌流不良會影響讀數;勿選用冰冷的肢體。

heading.zh: 疼痛評估與非藥物處置

points.en: Pain types: acute, chronic noncancer, chronic episodic (migraine, sickle cell crisis), cancer, idiopathic.
points.zh: 疼痛類型:急性、慢性非癌症、慢性間歇性(偏頭痛、鐮刀型紅血球危象)、癌症、特發性。

points.en: Pain is subjective; assess timing, location, severity, quality, aggravating and relieving factors. Use a 0-10 scale, or FACES/FLACC for children and nonverbal clients.
points.zh: 疼痛為主觀感受;評估時間、位置、強度、性質、加重與緩解因素。使用 0-10 量表,兒童與無法言語者用 FACES/FLACC。

points.en: Older adults may show pain as sleep disturbance, gait change, withdrawal or depression; consider culture and beliefs.
points.zh: 老年人疼痛可能表現為睡眠障礙、步態改變、社交減少或憂鬱;須考量文化與信仰。

points.en: Nonpharmacological: heat/cold (15-30 min with a barrier), massage, TENS, binders/elevation, distraction, relaxation, guided imagery, music, acupuncture, biofeedback.
points.zh: 非藥物措施:冷熱敷(隔層布、15-30 分鐘)、按摩、TENS、束帶/抬高、分散注意力、放鬆、引導想像、音樂、針灸、生理回饋。

points.en: Ask about herbal remedies because of drug interactions.
points.zh: 須詢問是否使用草藥,以免與藥物交互作用。

points.en: NSAIDs/aspirin: gastric irritation, bleeding, sodium and water retention, tinnitus; take with food; avoid in ulcer disease; potentiate anticoagulants.
points.zh: NSAIDs/阿斯匹靈:胃刺激、出血、鈉水滯留、耳鳴;隨餐服用;潰瘍者避免;會加強抗凝劑作用。

points.en: Ibuprofen can cause hypoglycemia with oral antidiabetics and toxicity with calcium channel blockers.
points.zh: ibuprofen 與口服降血糖藥併用可能低血糖,與鈣離子阻斷劑併用有中毒風險。

points.en: Acetaminophen: main risk is hepatotoxicity; self-treatment no more than 10 days in adults (5 in children); antidote acetylcysteine.
points.zh: acetaminophen:主要風險為肝毒性;成人自行用藥不超過 10 天(兒童 5 天);解毒劑為 acetylcysteine。

points.en: Opioids: give 30-60 min before painful activity; hold and call if RR below 12 or bradycardia; check BP, sedation, bowel/bladder; keep naloxone, O2 and resuscitation equipment; use an infusion pump for continuous or PCA IV.
points.zh: 鴉片類:於疼痛活動前 30-60 分鐘給予;呼吸低於 12 次/分或心搏過緩時暫停並通報;監測血壓、鎮靜程度、排便與排尿;備妥 naloxone、氧氣與急救設備;持續或 PCA 靜脈輸注須用輸液幫浦。

points.en: Adjuvants (amitriptyline, venlafaxine, gabapentin) help neuropathic pain.
points.zh: 輔助藥物(amitriptyline、venlafaxine、gabapentin)有助於神經病變性疼痛。

heading.en: Lab values: electrolytes and coagulation studies
heading.zh: 檢驗值:電解質與凝血功能

points.en: Sodium 135-145 mEq/L; potassium 3.5-5.0 mEq/L. Prolonged tourniquet or hemolysis can falsely raise potassium; do not draw from an arm with an infusion.
points.zh: 鈉 135-145 mEq/L;鉀 3.5-5.0 mEq/L。止血帶綁太久或溶血會使鉀假性升高;勿由有輸液的手臂抽血。

points.en: aPTT normal 30-40 sec; therapeutic heparin is 1.5-2.5 times normal (about 45-100 sec). Start bleeding precautions if over 100 sec; draw 1 hr before the next intermittent dose.
points.zh: aPTT 正常 30-40 秒;使用肝素治療目標為正常的 1.5-2.5 倍(約 45-100 秒)。超過 100 秒啟動出血防範;間歇給藥者於下次劑量前 1 小時抽血。

points.en: PT 11-12.5 sec; INR 0.81-1.20; warfarin keeps PT at 1.5-2 times control. PT over 25 sec or INR over 3.0 on warfarin means bleeding precautions.
points.zh: PT 11-12.5 秒;INR 0.81-1.20;warfarin 使 PT 維持在對照值 1.5-2 倍。服用 warfarin 者 PT 超過 25 秒或 INR 超過 3.0 須啟動出血防範。

points.en: High vitamin K intake (green leafy vegetables) shortens PT and lowers warfarin effect.
points.zh: 攝取大量維生素 K(深綠色葉菜)會縮短 PT、降低 warfarin 效果。

points.en: Platelets 150,000-400,000/mm3; low with chemotherapy, DIC, leukemia, hemorrhage; apply pressure to puncture sites 3-5 min.
points.zh: 血小板 150,000-400,000/mm3;化療、DIC、白血病、出血時降低;穿刺處加壓 3-5 分鐘。

heading.en: Lab values: CBC, lipids, glucose and renal tests
heading.zh: 檢驗值:血球、血脂、血糖與腎功能

points.en: Hemoglobin: male 14-18, female 12-16 g/dL. Hematocrit: male 42-52%, female 37-47%. Low in anemia and hemorrhage; hematocrit rises with dehydration and falls with overhydration.
points.zh: 血紅素:男 14-18、女 12-16 g/dL。血比容:男 42-52%、女 37-47%。貧血與出血時降低;脫水使血比容上升,水過多則下降。

points.en: Lipids (fast 12-14 hr): total cholesterol under 200, LDL under 100, HDL over 60 mg/dL; triglycerides male 40-160, female 35-135 mg/dL.
points.zh: 血脂(空腹 12-14 小時):總膽固醇低於 200、LDL 低於 100、HDL 高於 60 mg/dL;三酸甘油酯男 40-160、女 35-135 mg/dL。

points.en: Fasting glucose 70-99 mg/dL (fast 8-12 hr; hold morning insulin/oral agents until drawn). HbA1c reflects 3-4 months: normal under 5.7%, prediabetes 5.7-6.4%, diabetes 6.5% or more.
points.zh: 空腹血糖 70-99 mg/dL(禁食 8-12 小時;抽血前暫停早晨胰島素/口服藥)。HbA1c 反映 3-4 個月血糖控制:正常低於 5.7%,糖尿病前期 5.7-6.4%,糖尿病 6.5% 以上。

points.en: Creatinine: male 0.6-1.2, female 0.5-1.1 mg/dL (specific for renal function). BUN 10-20 mg/dL; raised by dehydration, GI bleeding, renal disease.
points.zh: 肌酸酐:男 0.6-1.2、女 0.5-1.1 mg/dL(腎功能的專一指標)。BUN 10-20 mg/dL;脫水、消化道出血、腎病時升高。

points.en: WBC 5,000-10,000/mm3; left shift (more immature neutrophils) suggests bacterial infection. Monitor WBC/differential in chemotherapy clients for neutropenia and infection.
points.zh: 白血球 5,000-10,000/mm3;左移(未成熟嗜中性球增加)提示細菌感染。化療患者須監測白血球及分類以防嗜中性球低下與感染。

critical_points.en: Adult norms: HR 60-100, RR 12-20, BP below 120/80, SpO2 95-100%; report SpO2 below 90%.
critical_points.zh: 成人正常值:心率 60-100、呼吸 12-20、血壓低於 120/80、SpO2 95-100%;SpO2 低於 90% 須通報。

critical_points.en: Apical pulse for 1 full minute before digoxin and beta blockers, with irregular pulse or heart disease, and in children under 2.
critical_points.zh: 給予 digoxin 與乙型阻斷劑前、脈搏不規則或心臟病、及 2 歲以下兒童,須測心尖脈滿 1 分鐘。

critical_points.en: Pulse deficit (radial lower than apical) indicates ineffective contractions; notify provider.
critical_points.zh: 脈搏短絀(橈動脈低於心尖)表示心臟收縮無效,須通報醫師。

critical_points.en: Cuff too small = falsely high BP; too large = falsely low. Avoid arm with IV, fistula, mastectomy side or trauma.
critical_points.zh: 壓脈帶太小血壓偏高;太大偏低。避開有輸液、瘻管、乳房切除側或外傷的手臂。

critical_points.en: No rectal temperatures with cardiac disease, rectal surgery, diarrhea, impaction or bleeding risk; no oral temperature with nasal congestion.
critical_points.zh: 心臟病、肛門手術、腹瀉、糞便嵌塞或出血風險者不量肛溫;鼻塞者不量口溫。

critical_points.en: Opioids: hold and notify if RR under 12 or bradycardia; keep naloxone available; assess 30 min after dose.
critical_points.zh: 鴉片類:呼吸低於 12 次/分或心搏過緩時暫停並通報;備妥 naloxone;給藥後 30 分鐘評估效果。

critical_points.en: Acetaminophen's major risk is hepatotoxicity; antidote acetylcysteine.
critical_points.zh: acetaminophen 主要風險為肝毒性;解毒劑為 acetylcysteine。

critical_points.en: NSAIDs increase bleeding, especially with warfarin; avoid with ulcer disease; ibuprofen with antidiabetics (hypoglycemia) or calcium channel blockers (toxicity).
critical_points.zh: NSAIDs 增加出血風險,尤其合併 warfarin;潰瘍者避免;ibuprofen 與降血糖藥(低血糖)或鈣離子阻斷劑(中毒)併用須通報。

critical_points.en: Heparin: aPTT target 1.5-2.5 x normal (about 45-100 sec); over 100 sec = bleeding precautions and notify provider.
critical_points.zh: 肝素:aPTT 目標為正常 1.5-2.5 倍(約 45-100 秒);超過 100 秒須啟動出血防範並通報。

critical_points.en: Warfarin: PT 1.5-2 x control, INR therapeutic about 2-3; PT over 25 sec or INR over 3.0 = bleeding precautions and hold dose per provider.
critical_points.zh: Warfarin:PT 為對照值 1.5-2 倍、INR 治療範圍約 2-3;PT 超過 25 秒或 INR 超過 3.0 須啟動出血防範並依醫囑暫停劑量。

critical_points.en: Potassium 3.5-5.0: report low values before giving furosemide to a cardiac client (ventricular dysrhythmia risk).
critical_points.zh: 鉀 3.5-5.0:心臟病患給 furosemide 前若血鉀偏低須通報(有心室心律不整風險)。

critical_points.en: Platelets 150,000-400,000; low counts in chemotherapy, DIC, leukemia; institute bleeding precautions per agency threshold.
critical_points.zh: 血小板 150,000-400,000;化療、DIC、白血病時偏低;依機構閾值啟動出血防範。

critical_points.en: HbA1c: 6.5% or higher is diabetes; 8% means chronic hyperglycemia, so teach prevention and recognition of hyperglycemia.
critical_points.zh: HbA1c 6.5% 以上為糖尿病;8% 表示長期高血糖,須教導預防與辨識高血糖。

critical_points.en: BUN 10-20 and creatinine 0.6-1.2 (male); BUN falls with adequate rehydration; creatinine is the more specific renal marker.
critical_points.zh: BUN 10-20、肌酸酐(男)0.6-1.2;補液充足時 BUN 下降;肌酸酐為較專一的腎功能指標。

critical_points.en: Neutropenic precautions for low WBC (e.g., 2000/mm3); monitor WBC with chemotherapy.
critical_points.zh: 白血球偏低(如 2000/mm3)須採嗜中性球低下防護;化療期間監測白血球。

critical_points.en: Lipid profile requires fasting 12-14 hr (water only) and no alcohol for 24 hr; fasting glucose requires 8-12 hr.
critical_points.zh: 血脂檢驗需空腹 12-14 小時(僅可喝水)且 24 小時內不飲酒;空腹血糖需禁食 8-12 小時。

mnemonics.en: Pulse grading 0-4+: 0 absent, 1+ weak, 2+ normal, 3+ full/increased, 4+ bounding.
mnemonics.zh: 脈搏分級 0-4+:0 無、1+ 微弱、2+ 正常、3+ 飽滿、4+ 洪大。

mnemonics.en: Heparin multiplies aPTT (30-40 sec) by 1.5-2.5; warfarin multiplies PT by 1.5-2 ('Heparin = aPTT, Warfarin = PT/INR').
mnemonics.zh: 肝素看 aPTT(30-40 秒)乘 1.5-2.5 倍;warfarin 看 PT/INR 乘 1.5-2 倍(「肝素 aPTT、華法林 PT/INR」)。

mnemonics.en: Opioid safety check: RR 12 or less than 12 = hold (R-12 rule); also sedation, pulse, BP.
mnemonics.zh: 鴉片類安全檢核:呼吸低於 12 次/分即暫停(12 規則),並檢查鎮靜程度、脈搏與血壓。

stem.en: A client with atrial fibrillation on warfarin has a PT of 35 seconds. What does the nurse anticipate?
stem.zh: 服用 warfarin 的心房顫動患者 PT 為 35 秒。護理師預期醫囑為何?

options.en: Holding the next dose of warfarin
Increasing the next dose of warfarin
Giving the next dose as scheduled

rationale.en: Normal PT is 11-12.5 sec and therapeutic is 1.5-2 times control; 35 sec exceeds 25 sec, so bleeding risk is high and the dose is held.
rationale.zh: PT 正常 11-12.5 秒、治療為對照 1.5-2 倍;35 秒已超過 25 秒,出血風險高,應暫停給藥。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client on a continuous heparin infusion for DVT has an aPTT of 65 seconds (control 30-40 sec). What action is needed?
stem.zh: 深部靜脈栓塞患者持續輸注肝素,aPTT 65 秒(對照 30-40 秒)。應採取何種行動?

rationale.en: Therapeutic aPTT is 1.5-2.5 times normal, roughly 45-100 seconds; 65 is therapeutic.
rationale.zh: 治療性 aPTT 為正常 1.5-2.5 倍,約 45-100 秒;65 秒在治療範圍內。

stem.en: A PCA hydromorphone client is drowsy with RR 11, pulse 52, BP 101/58, SpO2 93% on 3 L. What does the nurse do first?
stem.zh: 使用 PCA hydromorphone 的患者嗜睡,呼吸 11、脈搏 52、血壓 101/58、3 L 氧氣下 SpO2 93%。護理師首先做什麼?

options.zh: 查看 PCA 給藥紀錄

rationale.en: Assess level of consciousness and airway/breathing first; then stop the PCA, give naloxone as prescribed and notify the provider.
rationale.zh: 首先評估意識與呼吸道/呼吸;之後停止 PCA、依醫囑給 naloxone 並通知醫師。

stem.en: The nurse reviews labs. Which results should be reported? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 護理師檢視檢驗報告。哪些結果須通報?(複選)

rationale.en: Platelets are low, sodium is high and WBC is low. Potassium 5.0 and creatinine 1.0 are within normal limits.
rationale.zh: 血小板偏低、鈉偏高、白血球偏低;鉀 5.0 與肌酸酐 1.0 在正常範圍內。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client taking ibuprofen is also prescribed which medications that would require notifying the provider? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 服用 ibuprofen 的患者同時使用下列哪些藥物須通知醫師?(複選)

rationale.en: NSAIDs potentiate anticoagulants, can cause hypoglycemia with oral antidiabetics, and risk toxicity with calcium channel blockers. Statins have no noted interaction.
rationale.zh: NSAIDs 會加強抗凝劑作用、與口服降血糖藥併用可能低血糖、與鈣離子阻斷劑併用有中毒風險;statin 類無已知交互作用。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: Which temperature measurement choice by assistive personnel indicates a need for further teaching?
stem.zh: 輔助人員選擇下列哪種測量方式,表示需要再教導?

options.en: Oral temperature for a client with nasal congestion
Behind-the-ear temperature in a diaphoretic client
options.zh: 出汗患者於耳後量體溫

rationale.en: Nasal congestion interferes with closed-mouth breathing, so oral measurement should be avoided. The other choices are acceptable.
rationale.zh: 鼻塞會影響閉口呼吸,應避免量口溫;其他選項皆可接受。

source.title: Original practice question based on the chapter

stem.en: A client with diabetes has an HbA1c of 8%. The nurse plans to teach about which need?
stem.zh: 糖尿病患者 HbA1c 為 8%。護理師應教導何者?

rationale.en: HbA1c of 8% (above goal) reflects average estimated glucose of about 183 mg/dL over 3-4 months, meaning chronic hyperglycemia.
rationale.zh: HbA1c 8%(高於目標)相當於 3-4 個月平均血糖約 183 mg/dL,代表長期高血糖。

stem.en: A client with gastroenteritis and dehydration has received fluids. Which BUN value indicates adequate volume replacement?
stem.zh: 腸胃炎合併脫水患者已補液。下列哪個 BUN 值表示補液足夠?

rationale.en: Normal BUN is 10-20 mg/dL; 29 and 35 show continued dehydration, 3 suggests overload.
rationale.zh: BUN 正常 10-20 mg/dL;29 與 35 表示仍脫水,3 提示水分過多。
